value.name: Clean Energy Alliance (CEA)
value.notes: CEA's own homepage confirms Del Mar as one of its 7 member cities (Carlsbad, Del Mar, Escondido, Oceanside, San Marcos, Solana Beach, Vista) — Carlsbad, Del Mar, and Solana Beach were CEA's founding cities in 2019. Per CEA's own description: 'Clean Energy Alliance purchases power directly from power providers and/or builds energy generation sources' while 'SDG&E delivers energy, handles billing and serves customers.'
